name: bond-cockpit
description: Cockpit for bond: the current job (task, tool in flight, agent and workflow progress), the /bond:implement flow's progress in the status line, a strip under the prompt, and a docked pane that also lists the prompt-cache hit rate and time to expiry, the session's models and the rate-limit, context and cost usage. A mod of function hooks; needs a Claude Code build with plugin hooks modules.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto infers it (overage → 5m, a model switch's report, else 1h on a subscription and 5m on an API key); 5m or 1h fixes it
